sources.title: Locke Build Guides, Runes, Items, and Abilities - Patch 26.19

passive.name: Silver Stake
passive.text: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.

spells.name: Ritual Nails
spells.text: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.text: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.

spells.name: Ashen Pursuit
spells.text: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

spells.name: Purgatory
spells.text: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

damage.value: Locke deals magic damage with basic attacks and Ritual Nails, with stronger on-hit damage against targets missing health.

axis.value: Locke can open a short trade with Ritual Nails, then attack to consume the marks for more damage.

spikes.why: Locke gains more damage and a shorter cooldown as Ritual Nails ranks up.

spikes.at: When Ritual Nails reaches a 6-second cooldown
spikes.why: Locke can throw Soul Nails more often to mark enemies.

mistakes.value: Locke misses permanent execution-threshold stacks and a cooldown refund if he fails to pick up a dropped artifact.
Locke risks dealing damage to himself with Soul Ignition without accounting for its delayed healing.
